label: Welcome
title: Welcome to Odradek
body: Odradek is an asset viewer and exporter for Horizon Forbidden West and Death Stranding 2.
This guide covers the Graph panel, filtering, object references, bookmarks, and exporting. You can leave it open while using the app.

label: Graph
title: The Graph panel
body: The streaming graph is the game's index of resources and their dependencies. An object is a resource or piece of game data; a group contains related objects.

These objects are packed into game data files, not stored as a separate named file for each asset. The graph identifies objects by group ID and object index, not source filenames. That's why Odradek shows IDs and types rather than a familiar folder tree.
Browse by group under Groups, by type under Objects, or browse the game's root objects under Roots.
Double-click an object to open it, or select it and press Enter. Available viewers appear as tabs at the bottom of the editor.
A group's Dependencies are the groups it depends on. Its Dependents are groups that depend on it. Use Usages for references between individual objects.
Object IDs

[123:4] ObjectType
  |  |
  |  +-- object index within the group
  +----- group ID
In this example, the group ID is 123 and the object index is 4. Inside a group, only the object index may be shown.

label: Filtering
title: Filtering
body: Enter a query above the graph and press Enter. Ctrl+F focuses the filter when the graph has focus.
Use type:Texture to match type names containing “Texture”. Bare text such as Texture is not a valid query. The filter does not search asset filenames or object field values.
<ul>
• Match Case makes type-name matching case-sensitive.
• Match Whole Word requires the complete type name, rather than a substring.
• Combine conditions with not, and, and or (highest to lowest priority). Use parentheses to group conditions.
• has:roots keeps groups with root objects.
• has:subgroups keeps groups with dependencies; has:supergroups keeps groups with dependents.
group:123 filters the Groups branch. Replace 123 with your group ID. It does not restrict the separate Objects or Roots branches.
Clear the query and press Enter to remove the filter. Invalid queries show an error and leave the previous filter active.
Example queries
Select query text and press Ctrl+C to copy it.
<table cellpadding='5'>
type:TextureType names containing Texture
type:Mesh or type:TextureType names containing Mesh or Texture
group:123Group 123 under Groups; replace the ID
has:rootsGroups containing root objects
(type:Mesh or type:Texture) and not group:123Mesh or Texture types, excluding group 123 under Groups

label: Usages
title: Object references
body: Right-click an object and choose Show Usages, or select it and press Alt+F7.
On first use, click Scan game resources to build the link database. This can take a while; the database is saved for later sessions.
<ul>
• Incoming links are references to this object.
• Outgoing links are references from this object.

Another object  -->  Selected object  -->  Referenced object
        incoming link          outgoing link
Double-click a result (or select it and press Enter) to open it. Incoming results also take you to the referencing field.
Choose Show Usages on a result to inspect its references. The panel's Back / Forward arrows return to previous usages searches.

label: Bookmarks
title: Bookmarks
body: Right-click an object or group in the Graph panel and choose Add Bookmark. Enter a name. New bookmarks appear under User bookmarks.
Open the Bookmarks panel using its tool-strip button. Double-click an object bookmark, or select it and press Enter, to open the object.
Folders and names
<ul>
• Right-click User bookmarks or a folder and choose New Folder.... You can also press Ctrl+Shift+N with the folder selected.
• Drag bookmarks or folders onto a folder to move them. Entries are sorted by name, with folders first.
• Right-click an entry and choose Rename Bookmark... or Rename Folder... to change its name.
Removing bookmarks

Right-click a bookmarked item and choose Delete Bookmark. To remove a folder, choose Delete Folder or select it and press Delete. Deleting a folder also removes its bookmarks and subfolders; nonempty folders require confirmation.
Removing a bookmark does not delete game data. Bookmarks and folders are saved with the app's settings and restored on later launches.

label: Exporting
title: Exporting
body: Select one or more objects, then choose Export As... from the right-click menu. Choose a format and an output location.
Use Ctrl-click to add objects or Shift-click to select a range. Selecting a group heading does not export its contents.
Only formats supported by every selected object are shown. If Export As... is missing, try selecting a single supported object.
Common formats
<ul>
• Models: CAST
• Textures: PNG or DDS
• Audio: WAV, or supported source formats such as WEM or AT9
Batch and multi-file exports ask for a directory; a single-file export asks for a filename. Existing output files may be overwritten.
Wait for the completion message. If some objects failed to export, check the console output for details.
